verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a public programmatic API. The Python API page covers the core v1.0 operations (remember, recall, improve, forget), each with its own docs page. An API reference section shows how to run the server container on port 8000. However, the HTTP endpoints themselves are not described in the evidence, and probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the standard docs paths. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence of documented REST endpoint details (auth, routes), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
